Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Deine Aufgaben Bei uns ist jeder Spezialist in seinem Fachgebiet - niemand muss alles können. Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden, vom Serverraum bis in die Cloud. - Du installierst, aktualisierst und betreust Domänencontroller sowie File- und Anwendungsserver - On-Premise und in Cloud-Umgebungen. - Du administrierst Microsoft 365, insbesondere Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune. - Du richtest Clients ein und erstellst dafür die passenden Intune-Richtlinien und Bereitstellungspläne. - Du installierst Fachanwendungen unserer Kunden wie ERP- oder Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme, begleitest Updates und stimmst dich dabei mit den Softwareherstellern ab. - Du bindest Kundeninfrastrukturen in unser Monitoring ein - damit wir Probleme erkennen, bevor unsere Kunden sie bemerken. - Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und dokumentierst sauber in unserer Service-Plattform Hindeo. jobs.description: About the AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world s largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister s office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. Team Description      Risks from misaligned AI systems are growing increasingly important as AI systems become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. Understanding these risks and stress-testing mitigations is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely and beneficially in the future.     The Alignment Red Team is a specialised subteam within AISI s wider Red Team focused on detecting and evaluating misalignment in frontier AI systems. We perform novel research to develop techniques for finding misalignment, and pre- and post-deployment evaluations of frontier AI systems to understand loss-of-control risks associated with models, such as deceptive alignment, research sabotage, and reward-seeking. We share our findings with frontier AI companies and the UK and allied governments, to inform their respective deployments, research, and policy-making. We also work directly with safety teams at frontier labs, sharing our evaluation findings to help improve their model alignment training and monitoring methodology.   We have conducted pre-deployment testing with multiple frontier AI companies for propensities related to research sabotage , cheating and unsanctioned cyber-attacks . jobs.title: KI WEG- Verwalter (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über Buena Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. Mit über 90.000 verwalteten Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Hausverwaltungen sind wir in den letzten drei Jahren zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden. Über die Rolle Du bist echter WEG-Profi, kennst den Alltag in der Verwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Prozesse unklar sind. Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an: Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland, und du überführst sie direkt vor Ort in den modernen Buena-Betrieb. Dein Wohnort in Deutschland ist zweitrangig – wichtig ist deine hohe Reisebereitschaft und deine WEG-Expertise. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen, reibungslosem WEG-Tagesgeschäft und lokalen Teams, die mit der Buena-Software spürbar besser arbeiten als vorher. Verantwortlichkeiten Du tauchst tief in das WEG-Tagesgeschäft unserer neu übernommenen Verwaltungen ein, identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und baust bestehende Rückstände gezielt ab. Du begleitest und steuerst die operative Umstellung auf unsere Buena-Software direkt vor Ort bei den Teams. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. jobs.description: Please note the internal job title is: Principal Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Want to build the go-to-market engine for a fast growing payments business? Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead to be part of our Fintech department. Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. jobs.title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question. This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you. jobs.title: Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM). At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system? You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements. The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level. This is a hands-on R&D role spanning quantum physics, experimental hardware, and sensor development. You will take ideas from first principles through experiments and prototypes to validated technologies that can be transferred into our products. jobs.title: Growth Lead (3-month contract)
jobs.description: About KidsHustle KidsHustle is the first job platform where busy adults can safely hire local teenagers. KidsHustle is live on the App Store and Google Play, and is a trading name of Urban Mechanics Ltd. This is a hands-on launch role, not a strategy or brand position. jobs.title: Value Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: About GeneralMind GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. About the role As a Value Engineer at GeneralMind, the customer is yours from the first pitch onwards - through the close, the rollout, and everything that follows. You work at the core of our go-to-market, side by side with the founders, marketing, product, and sales ops, refining how we sell and keeping the pace high. You join a small, ambitious team and help define how we win customers and grow them across international markets. Whether you come from a generalist background or have years of selling behind you matters less than this: you pick things up quickly, you are comfortable with complex problems, and you can explain value in plain terms. The job sits where AI, SaaS, and operational excellence (supply chain, for example) meet. You will use AI tools in your daily work and get noticeably better at your job because of it. What You'll Do Take ownership of the customer after the first pitch and carry the relationship through close, integration, and later expansion. Build lasting relationships with C-level executives and their teams inside large, complex enterprises. Lead customers through deep dives and product Go-Lives, then keep the relationship growing over time. Develop a thorough understanding of what our customers struggle with, particularly in operational areas such as supply chain. Work closely with product engineers and founders

jobs.description: Your priority for 2027 is pipeline. You turn marketing into a predictable source of qualified pipeline in two motions. Net new: winning new enterprise logos in Europe and the US. Expansion: growing with our existing clients into new business units, countries, and use cases, with a pipeline target you share with Customer Success and Account Management. Brand, content, and events all matter, and each is measured by what it contributes to these two motions. In the interview process, you will walk us through how you would build this pipeline in your first 12 months. Retorio roughly triples in size every year, sells to large enterprises, and already generates around 40% of its pipeline organically. Your mandate is to build a scalable lead generation engine that works in Europe, our home market where we want to be the clear number one, and in the US, where we have opened an office in New York. You do this with deliberately modest ad budgets and a small team (today one events specialist and one lead generation specialist) that will grow over time. Our growth strategy is to let our customers speak for us: reference stories, video case studies, and communities in which decision makers at large enterprises share their use cases and results and attract their peers. To support that pipeline, you also establish Retorio as the credible, science-based voice in an increasingly competitive AI sales coaching category, and you give the brand an external appearance that is professional enough for enterprise buyers and distinct enough to stand out. You report directly to the founder/Co-CEO. This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer. What this role actually is You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on: • Whether the response makes sense • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part. What you'll be doing • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4) • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code What we mean by "taste" We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like: • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say? • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct? • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output? • Would this interaction build or erode trust? jobs.title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the

jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. Vous représenterez également notre collectif et nos façons de travailler auprès de l'équipe DATA IA, et relaierez ses préconisations sur Power BI et Looker Studio. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. We're an applied AI company running frontline workforce operations for staffing firms and large employers of hourly and shift workers. Our software does the work that sits today with recruiters, compliance teams and outsourced back offices, from a worker's first application into the job itself. We support 150,000 workers a month across more than 80 countries, for customers including Job&Talent, Deel, Wonolo, BGSF, ProLink and Multiplier. Our Series A was led by Earlybird Venture Capital alongside Gradient Ventures and Y Combinator, and we're growing our team in London. The role Open Firstwork's enterprise market in the UK and Europe, with employers whose frontline workforces span many sites and countries, each with its own rules. That complexity is where Firstwork is strongest. Firstwork sits on top of the systems that customers already use, lands in one workflow or site, and expands across the business. You'll sell to UK care home groups, logistics and distribution, retail, hospitality and facilities management, plus German facilities management and real estate services. Your buyers are Group HR Directors, Chief People Officers, CFOs, Operations Directors, Heads of Resourcing and Heads of Compliance, with HRIS leads in every deal. jobs.description: My GOOD LIFE recrute ! Rejoignez un projet innovant à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la vidéo et de l’Activité Physique Adaptée My GOOD LIFE développe des solutions et des contenus visant à promouvoir l’Activité Physique Adaptée auprès de différents publics, notamment les personnes souhaitant reprendre une activité physique, préserver leur autonomie ou améliorer leur qualité de vie. Dans le cadre de son développement, My GOOD LIFE souhaite intégrer l’intelligence artificielle générative à la conception de supports vidéo pédagogiques, accessibles et adaptés aux besoins des différents publics. Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons notre futur(e) : Stagiaire en intelligence artificielle générative et création de contenus vidéo APA (H/F) Votre mission Encadré(e) par notre équipe, vous participez à la conception et à la production de vidéos d’Activité Physique Adaptée grâce aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative. Votre mission consiste à expérimenter différents outils, concevoir et optimiser des prompts, générer des contenus vidéo et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de leur qualité pédagogique et visuelle. À la fois créatif(ve), rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous participez à la construction d’une méthodologie permettant de produire des contenus cohérents, réalistes, accessibles et adaptés aux objectifs de l’Activité Physique Adaptée. Vos principales responsabilités Vous intervenez notamment sur les volets suivants : Concevoir, tester et optimiser des prompts destinés aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative. Générer des vidéos illustrant des mouvements, exercices et séances d’Activité Physique Adaptée. Tester et comparer différentes solutions de génération vidéo, d’animation, d’avatars et, si nécessaire, de voix off. Améliorer la fluidité des mouvements, la posture, la cohérence visuelle et la clarté des consignes proposées. Participer à la création de contenus pédagogiques adaptés à différents publics et niveaux de pratique. Analys

jobs.title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts. Vos missions principales : 1. Entrepôts et stocks Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process. Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant. Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation. 2. Retours et reconditionnement Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie. Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées. 3. Performance et coûts Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
jobs.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: At NetBox Labs , our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud. We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering. In this role you will: Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices. Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines. Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release. Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces. Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down. Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up. Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring. jobs.title: Psychosociaal Therapeut
jobs.description: BetterHelp – Word onderdeel van het grootste online therapieplatform ter wereld! Bij BetterHelp hebben we als missie om barrières voor therapie weg te nemen en geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor iedereen toegankelijk te maken. Sinds onze oprichting in 2013 zijn we uitgegroeid tot de grootste online therapie dienst ter wereld, met betaalbare en toegankelijke therapie in meer dan 210 landen. Ter voorbereiding op onze EU-lancering in Nederland zoeken wij gekwalificeerde counselors en therapeuten om ons netwerk te versterken. Sluit u aan bij het grootste online counseling platform ter wereld! Voordelen van werken bij BetterHelp: Werk met een eersteklas organisatie tijdens onze uitbreiding in Europa. Alles-in-één platform: Voer uw sessies soepel uit zonder u zorgen te maken over klantwerving, facturatie of administratieve taken—wij nemen dat allemaal voor onze rekening! Flexibiliteit: Geef therapiesessies vanaf elke locatie, ondersteund door een toonaangevend wereldwijd platform. Gespecialiseerde cliëntgroepen: Richt u op de gebieden waar u het meest gepassioneerd over bent. Geen overheadkosten: Er worden nooit kosten in rekening gebracht bij de counselor. Autonomie over klinische beslissingen: U bent de gekwalificeerde en ervaren counselor. BetterHelp respecteert uw klinische oordeel en expertise om de meest effectieve en geschikte aanpak voor elke cliënt te bepalen. Ondersteuning en hulpmiddelen: Counselors op het BetterHelp-platform ontvangen gratis toegang tot een BetterHelp-account – zodat u ook tijd kunt besteden aan uw eigen welzijn! Concurrerende vergoeding en bonussen: Verdien €500 wanneer u uw eerste cliënt binnen 14 dagen na aanmelding accepteert. (Eerste-cliëntbonussen kunnen wijzigen, dus dit is het perfecte moment om u aan te sluiten!) Voor wie is dit van toepassing: Counselors die flexibiliteit zoeken om teletherapie vanaf elke locatie te geven. Counselors die zich willen richten op klinisch werk—wij nemen de werving van cliënten, facturatie en ondersteuning

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes. You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions. You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship. What we're looking for Essentials 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership

jobs.description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou! Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Bouw jij mee? Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: Backend development; Frontend development; Embedded Software Development; DevOps; Security; Software testing. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? jobs.title: Stagiair Business Control
jobs.description: Ben jij er klaar voor om impact te hebben op een van de belangrijkste sectoren in de wereld? Bij IXON connecten wij machines met hun makers. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Hier krijg jij energie van Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Wij geloven dat het geluk van de mens hem zit in het hebben van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en de kans om te groeien. Business control heeft daar een enorme impact op! Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business! Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten: De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen; Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews); Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling; Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijnt

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. jobs.title: Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D_CDD 36 mois
tags: ingénierie et services de la santé
jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. Identifier les sources de biais par une analyse centrée sur les données. Concevoir et évaluer des stratégies centrées sur les données pour atténuer les biais. Contribuer aux activités transverses du projet. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez une solide expérience en recherche expérimentale et en méthodes statistiques avancées. Votre expertise inclut la conception d’expériences contrôlées, l’évaluation des incertitudes, la gestion des facteurs de confusion, ainsi que la prévention des fuites d’information (data leakage). ✔️ Maîtrisant Python et un framework comme PyTorch, vous savez modifier, tester et déboguer du code de recherche avec efficacité. Vos compétences couvrent des domaines clés tels que : Vision par ordinateur, reconstruction 3D et géométrie 3D, Modèles statistiques de forme ou informatique médicale, Équité algorithmique, robustesse, généralisation et génération de données synthétiques. ✔️ Vous excellez dans l’évaluation des performances et des biais, via des analyses par sous-groupes, l’interprétation des disparités et un examen rigoureux des limites. Une expérie

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation. Requirements Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch. Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: About Shiftbase We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way. We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro. About the role You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
